assertions.name: habiro_cofactors_not_salem
assertions.source: each non-cyclotomic cofactor (n=6..9) has ≥2 off-circle reciprocal pairs (off-pairs [2, 2, 4, 7]) — not the single off-circle pair a Salem polynomial requires — so the cofactors are generic bar-even non-cyclotomic, not Salem/Lehmer; the n=6 boundary is the onset of non-q-holonomic content.

description: Classifies the Habiro-tail non-cyclotomic cofactor roots (lever-1/z2bn). REFUTES the Salem/Lehmer hypothesis: each cofactor (n=6..9) has ≥2 off-circle reciprocal pairs (off-pairs 2,2,4,7), not the single pair a Salem number requires — they are generic bar-even non-cyclotomic polynomials with mixed on/off-circle roots. So the n=6 boundary is the onset of non-q-holonomic content, NOT a distinguished number-theoretic class. Magnitudes not interpreted (numerology guard). Structural invariants ((q−1)² double root, bar-evenness, cyclotomic→non-cyclotomic at n=6) unchanged. Binding D(n), not Q_β c_k. Scope-(a), no fit, no wiring.
